title: Registry of Tibial plateau fractures
summary:
- Monocentric longitudinal NIS on patients who have suffered a tibial head fracture and who are observed during outpatient follow-up appointments up to 12 months after the accident
- PROMS are collected after 12 months using survey links sent by email

interventions.name: Longitudinal observation of patients over 18 years of age who have suffered a tibial plateau fracture

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- obtained tibial head fracture S82.11 or S82.18,
- capable of giving consent,
- at least 18 years old
Exclusion criteria:
- Members of a vulnerable group
- Age under 18 at the time of consent
- Language barrier or cognitive impairment
